<script>
"use strict";
(function(){
const D=id=>JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
const EV=D('data-events'), FO=D('data-forest'), CL=D('data-closure'), MG=D('data-margins'), CA=D('data-cases'), EX=D('data-example');
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
const C={accent:'#0b5cad',green:'#1f7a4d',amber:'#b35c00',muted:'#8a9099',ink:'#1b1f24',ink2:'#50565f',grid:'#e6e6e0',light:'#b8bec6'};
const FOLDS=EV.folds;
const ROWS=EV.rows.map((r,i)=>({i,fold:r[0],concept:EV.concepts[r[1]],host:EV.hosts[r[2]],year:r[3],share:r[4],ct:r[5],np:r[6],y:r[7],est:r[8],pb:r[9],pm:r[10],fg:EV.field_groups[r[11]]}));
const byFold=[0,1,2].map(f=>ROWS.filter(r=>r.fold===f));
const fmt=(x,d)=>x==null?'n/a':Number(x).toFixed(d);
const fmtInt=x=>Number(x).toLocaleString('en-US');
const pct=(x,d=0)=>(100*x).toFixed(d)+'%';
const cap=s=>s.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+s.slice(1);
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
function titleCase(s){return s.replace(/\b([a-z])/g,m=>m.toUpperCase()).replace(/\bQcd\b/,'QCD').replace(/\bMmwave\b/,'mmWave');}

/* ---------- svg helpers ---------- */
function el(tag,attrs,parent){const e=document.createElementNS(NS,tag);if(attrs)for(const k in attrs)e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);if(parent)parent.appendChild(e);return e;}
function tx(parent,x,y,s,attrs){const t=el('text',Object.assign({x,y,'font-size':13,fill:C.ink},attrs||{}),parent);t.textContent=s;return t;}
const MT=document.getElementById('measure-t');
function tw(s,size,weight){MT.setAttribute('font-size',size||13);MT.setAttribute('font-weight',weight||400);MT.setAttribute('font-family',getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily);MT.textContent=s;return MT.getComputedTextLength();}
function fit(s,size,weight,maxW){if(tw(s,size,weight)<=maxW)return s;let t=s;while(t.length>3&&tw(t+'…',size,weight)>maxW)t=t.slice(0,-1);return t.replace(/[\s,]+$/,'')+'…';}

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const TIP=$('#charttip');let tipOwner=null;
function showTip(node,html){tipOwner=node;TIP.innerHTML=html;TIP.classList.add('show');document.querySelectorAll('.mark.on').forEach(m=>m.classList.remove('on'));node.classList.add('on');
  const r=node.getBoundingClientRect();const tr=TIP.getBoundingClientRect();let x=r.left+r.width/2-tr.width/2+window.scrollX;x=Math.max(window.scrollX+8,Math.min(x,window.scrollX+document.documentElement.clientWidth-tr.width-8));let y=r.top+window.scrollY-tr.height-10;if(y<window.scrollY+56)y=r.bottom+window.scrollY+10;TIP.style.left=x+'px';TIP.style.top=y+'px';}
function hideTip(node){if(node&&tipOwner!==node)return;TIP.classList.remove('show');if(tipOwner)tipOwner.classList.remove('on');tipOwner=null;}
function bindMark(g,html,label,onAct){g.setAttribute('class',(g.getAttribute('class')||'')+' mark');g.setAttribute('tabindex','0');g.setAttribute('role','button');g.setAttribute('aria-label',label);
  g.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>showTip(g,html));g.addEventListener('focus',()=>showTip(g,html));
  g.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();showTip(g,html);if(onAct)onAct();});
  g.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();showTip(g,html);if(onAct)onAct();}});
  g.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>hideTip(g));g.addEventListener('blur',()=>hideTip(g));}
document.addEventListener('click',()=>hideTip());
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){hideTip();closeTerms();}});

/* ---------- ticks ---------- */
function niceTicks(a,b,n){const span=b-a;let step=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(span/n)));const err=span/n/step;if(err>=7.5)step*=10;else if(err>=3.5)step*=5;else if(err>=1.5)step*=2;const out=[];for(let v=Math.ceil(a/step)*step;v<=b+1e-9;v+=step)out.push(+v.toFixed(10));return out;}
const LOGT=[0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,1,1.1,1.2,1.3,1.4,1.5,1.6,1.8,2,2.5,3];

/* ---------- generic horizontal chart: dots with CI, or bars ---------- */
function hchart(host,o){
  host.innerHTML='';const W=Math.max(280,host.clientWidth);const rowH=o.rowH||(o.rows.some(r=>r.sub)?46:30);
  const lab=o.rows.map(r=>r.label),sub=o.rows.map(r=>r.sub||'');
  let lw=0;o.rows.forEach(r=>{lw=Math.max(lw,tw(r.label,13,r.bold?700:600),r.sub?tw(r.sub,12):0);});
  const maxL=Math.floor(W*(W<520?0.5:0.42));lw=Math.min(lw,maxL);
  const x0=lw+14,x1=W-14,top=8,n=o.rows.length,axisY=top+n*rowH+4;
  const log=o.scale==='log';
  let lo=o.domain[0],hi=o.domain[1];
  const sx=v=>log?x0+(Math.log(v)-Math.log(lo))/(Math.log(hi)-Math.log(lo))*(x1-x0):x0+(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*(x1-x0);
  const svg=el('svg',{width:W,role:'group','aria-label':o.aria||'chart'},host);
  let ticks=log?LOGT.filter(t=>t>=lo-1e-9&&t<=hi+1e-9):niceTicks(lo,hi,6);
  const tf=o.tickFmt||(v=>String(+v.toFixed(3)));
  const tickW=Math.max(...ticks.map(t=>tw(tf(t),12)))+14;
  while(ticks.length>2){let ok=true;for(let i=1;i<ticks.length;i++)if(sx(ticks[i])-sx(ticks[i-1])<tickW)ok=false;if(ok)break;ticks=ticks.filter((t,i)=>i%2===0||(log&&t===1));}
  const gg=el('g',{},svg);
  ticks.forEach(t=>{const x=sx(t);el('line',{x1:x,x2:x,y1:top,y2:axisY,stroke:C.grid},gg);tx(gg,x,axisY+16,tf(t),{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle',fill:C.ink2});});
  el('line',{x1:x0,x2:x1,y1:axisY,y2:axisY,stroke:'#b9b9b2'},gg);
  if(o.nullLine!=null){const x=sx(o.nullLine);el('line',{x1:x,x2:x,y1:top-4,y2:axisY,stroke:C.ink2,'stroke-dasharray':'4 3','stroke-width':1.5},gg);}
  tx(svg,(x0+x1)/2,axisY+38,o.xTitle,{'font-size':13,'text-anchor':'middle',fill:C.ink2});
  o.rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const cy=top+i*rowH+rowH/2;const g=el('g',{},svg);
    el('rect',{class:'hit',x:0,y:cy-rowH/2+1,width:W,height:rowH-2,fill:'transparent',rx:4},g);
    if(r.sub){tx(g,0,cy-4,fit(r.label,13,r.bold?700:600,lw),{'font-weight':r.bold?700:600});tx(g,0,cy+13,fit(r.sub,12,400,lw),{'font-size':12,fill:C.ink2});}
    else tx(g,0,cy+4,fit(r.label,13,r.bold?700:600,lw),{'font-weight':r.bold?700:600});
    const col=r.color||C.accent;
    if(o.bars){const b=o.barBase!=null?o.barBase:0;const xa=sx(b),xb=sx(r.est);el('rect',{x:Math.min(xa,xb),y:cy-Math.min(10,rowH/2-4),width:Math.max(1,Math.abs(xb-xa)),height:Math.min(20,rowH-8),fill:col,rx:2},g);}
    else{
      if(r.lo!=null){el('line',{x1:sx(Math.max(r.lo,lo)),x2:sx(Math.min(r.hi,hi)),y1:cy,y2:cy,stroke:col,'stroke-width':2.2},g);}
      if(r.shape==='diamond')el('path',{d:`M${sx(r.est)} ${cy-7}L${sx(r.est)+7} ${cy}L${sx(r.est)} ${cy+7}L${sx(r.est)-7} ${cy}Z`,fill:col},g);
      else el('circle',{cx:sx(r.est),cy,r:6,fill:r.open?'#fff':col,stroke:col,'stroke-width':2},g);
    }
    if(r.tip)bindMark(g,r.tip,r.aria||r.label,r.onAct);
  });
  svg.setAttribute('height',axisY+48);
  return svg;
}
function extent(vals,pad,incl){let a=Math.min(...vals),b=Math.max(...vals);if(incl!=null){a=Math.min(a,incl);b=Math.max(b,incl);}const s=(b-a)||1;return[a-s*pad,b+s*pad];}

/* ---------- term tooltips ---------- */
const TERMS={
 hostentry:['Host-entry event','The first year in which a concept appears in a non-origin subfield together with at least five co-occurring partner terms.'],
 share:['Host-vocabulary share','The tag-weighted mean of each partner’s pre-entry publication share in the host subfield, where each co-occurrence edge is weighted by its association strength.'],
 ct:['Co-transfer','The fraction of entry partners that were origin companions of the concept in the five years before entry.'],
 uptake:['Five-year newcomer uptake','The count of host-subfield papers by author-disjoint newcomers (authors with no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors) during the five years after entry.'],
 irr:['Incidence-rate ratio (IRR)','The multiplicative change in expected newcomer papers for a one-standard-deviation increase in host-vocabulary share; 1 means no effect.'],
 ppml:['PPML','Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood regression, here with concept-clustered standard errors.'],
 coprimary:['Co-primary specification','PPML with concept, entry-year and host fixed effects. A pre-declared thin-cell rule made it co-primary when the primary specification kept under 30% of events or fewer than 50 concept clusters.'],
 primary:['Primary specification','PPML with concept-by-entry-year and host-by-entry-year fixed effects; it absorbs more confounding but keeps fewer events.'],
 screen:['Screen fold','The part of the concept pool used to develop and first test the analysis: 247 emerging concepts, 202 after grounding filters.'],
 heldout:['Held-out fold','119 emerging concepts (100 after grounding) split off by a SHA-1 hash on concept identifiers; their outcomes stayed sealed under a hash-checked specification and were opened once.'],
 mesh:['MeSH population','191 new biomedical concepts drawn from new MeSH descriptors, analysed under a frozen specification; the replication covers biomedicine-to-biomedicine entries only.'],
 ivw:['IVW','Inverse-variance weighting: estimates from separate folds are pooled with weights equal to one over their variance.'],
 extensive:['Extensive margin','Whether any newcomer uptake starts, estimated with a linear probability model, in percentage points per SD.'],
 intensive:['Intensive margin','The count of newcomer papers given that uptake started, estimated with PPML conditional on uptake.'],
 eup:['Sustained uptake (E_up)','An emergence label promoted after the pre-declared label produced only 4 onsets; it is post hoc, and every RQ1 result uses it.'],
 persist:['Persistent-neighbour closure','The closure coefficient restricted to the top-20 neighbours present in both year y and year y−1.'],
 burt:['Burt constraint','A measure of redundancy in the weighted ego network; brokerage across structural holes means low constraint.'],
 r1dead:['R1_DEAD','The frozen kill mapping’s verdict on the held-out RQ1 test: structural precursors of sustained uptake are volume/churn correlates.'],
 holm:['Holm correction','A step-down adjustment of p-values for testing several closure measures at once.'],
 established:['Binary establishment','At least three newcomer papers, with host papers in at least three of the five years.']
};
let openTerm=null;
function closeTerms(){document.querySelectorAll('.termtip').forEach(t=>t.hidden=true);openTerm=null;}
function placeTerm(btn,tip){tip.hidden=false;const r=btn.getBoundingClientRect();const w=Math.min(320,document.documentElement.clientWidth-24);tip.style.maxWidth=w+'px';const tr=tip.getBoundingClientRect();let x=r.left+window.scrollX;x=Math.max(window.scrollX+12,Math.min(x,window.scrollX+document.documentElement.clientWidth-tr.width-12));tip.style.left=x+'px';tip.style.top=(r.bottom+window.scrollY+6)+'px';}
let tcount=0;
document.querySelectorAll('button.term').forEach(btn=>{
  const k=btn.dataset.term;const d=TERMS[k];if(!d)return;const id='tt-'+k+'-'+(tcount++);
  btn.type='button';
  const tip=document.createElement('div');tip.className='termtip';tip.id=id;tip.setAttribute('role','tooltip');tip.hidden=true;tip.innerHTML='<strong>'+esc(d[0])+'</strong>'+esc(d[1]);document.body.appendChild(tip);
  btn.setAttribute('aria-describedby',id);
  const open=()=>{if(openTerm&&openTerm!==tip)openTerm.hidden=true;placeTerm(btn,tip);openTerm=tip;};
  btn.addEventListener('mouseenter',open);btn.addEventListener('focus',open);
  btn.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();open();});
  btn.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{if(document.activeElement!==btn){tip.hidden=true;}});
  btn.addEventListener('blur',()=>{tip.hidden=true;});
});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('button.term'))closeTerms();});
const gl=$('#gloss');Object.keys(TERMS).forEach(k=>{const dt=document.createElement('dt');dt.textContent=TERMS[k][0];const dd=document.createElement('dd');dd.textContent=TERMS[k][1];gl.append(dt,dd);});

function radio(name){return document.querySelector(`input[name="${name}"]:checked`).value;}
function fillFold(sel,withCounts){FOLDS.forEach((f,i)=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=i;o.textContent=f+(withCounts?` (${fmtInt(byFold[i].length)} entries)`:'');sel.appendChild(o);});}

/* ================= THE FINDING ================= */
const FR=FO.rows;const fr=(key,reg)=>FR.find(r=>r.key===key&&r.reg===reg);
{const h=fr('ho_co','A');$('#bignum').textContent='×'+h.est_s;$('#bignum-cap').textContent=`IRR per SD on the held-out fold, 95% CI ${h.lo_s} to ${h.hi_s} (${fmtInt(h.N)} events, ${h.G} concept clusters, p = ${h.p_s}). Screen ${fr('scr_co','A').est_s}, MeSH ${fr('mesh_co','A').est_s}.`;}
function drawForest(){
  const spec=radio('f-spec'),showCT=$('#f-ct').checked;
  const keys=spec==='co'?['scr_co','ho_co','mesh_co','ivw']:['scr_pri','ho_pri','mesh_pri'];
  const rows=[];
  keys.forEach(k=>{
    const a=fr(k,'A');if(!a)return;
    const isIVW=k==='ivw',isMesh=k.startsWith('mesh');
    const stats=`${a.est_s} [${a.lo_s}, ${a.hi_s}]`+(a.p_s?` · p ${a.p_s.startsWith('<')?a.p_s:'= '+a.p_s}`:'');
    const nG=a.N?`N ${fmtInt(a.N)}, G ${a.G}`:'Screen and MeSH co-primary, I² = '+FO.I2;
    rows.push({label:a.fold+' · host share',sub:stats,est:a.est,lo:a.lo,hi:a.hi,bold:true,color:isIVW?C.amber:(isMesh?C.green:C.accent),shape:isIVW?'diamond':'dot',open:spec==='pri',
      tip:`<b>${esc(a.fold)}, ${spec==='co'?'co-primary':'primary'}: host-vocabulary share</b><br>IRR per SD ${a.est_s}, 95% CI ${a.lo_s} to ${a.hi_s}${a.p_s?'<br>p = '+a.p_s:''}<br>${nG}`,aria:`${a.fold} host-vocabulary share IRR ${a.est_s}, CI ${a.lo_s} to ${a.hi_s}`});
    const c=fr(k,'CT');
    if(showCT&&c)rows.push({label:a.fold+' · co-transfer',sub:`${c.est_s} [${c.lo_s}, ${c.hi_s}] · p = ${c.p_s}`,est:c.est,lo:c.lo,hi:c.hi,color:C.muted,shape:'diamond',
      tip:`<b>${esc(a.fold)}: co-transfer</b><br>IRR per SD ${c.est_s}, 95% CI ${c.lo_s} to ${c.hi_s}<br>p = ${c.p_s}`,aria:`${a.fold} co-transfer IRR ${c.est_s}, CI ${c.lo_s} to ${c.hi_s}`});
  });
  hchart($('#c-forest'),{rows,scale:'log',domain:[0.55,2.1],nullLine:1,xTitle:'IRR per SD (log scale)',aria:'Forest plot of incidence-rate ratios by fold',tickFmt:v=>String(v)});
  const A=keys.filter(k=>k!=='ivw').map(k=>fr(k,'A'));const sig=A.filter(a=>a.lo>1);
  let t;
  if(spec==='co'){const cts=['scr_co','ho_co','mesh_co'].map(k=>fr(k,'CT'));const ctNull=cts.every(c=>c.lo<=1&&c.hi>=1);
    t=`Co-primary: host-vocabulary share has an interval above 1 on ${sig.length} of ${A.length} folds (${A.map(a=>a.fold+' '+a.est_s).join(', ')}; IVW pool ${fr('ivw','A').est_s})`+(showCT?`, while co-transfer ${ctNull?'includes 1 on every fold':'excludes 1 somewhere'}.`:'.');}
  else{const h=fr('ho_pri','A');t=`Primary (strict FE): the interval clears 1 on ${sig.length} of ${A.length} folds (${sig.map(a=>a.fold+' '+a.est_s).join(', ')||'none'}). On the held-out fold it is ${h.est_s} [${h.lo_s}, ${h.hi_s}] with only ${h.G} clusters, which the pre-registration declared underpowered.`;}
  $('#t-forest').textContent=t;
}
document.querySelectorAll('input[name="f-spec"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener('change',drawForest));$('#f-ct').addEventListener('change',drawForest);

/* ================= STEPPER ================= */
const ex=EX;const sdS=ex.screen_sd;
const yrs=Object.keys(ex.counts_by_year).map(Number);
const earlyYears=[ex.F,ex.F+1,ex.F+2].map(y=>`${y}: ${ex.counts_by_year[y]}`).join(', ');
const STAGES=[
 {name:'Concept pool',short:['Concept','pool'],
  in:`Noun phrases first seen in OpenAlex titles and abstracts between 2005 and 2016.`,
  do:`Keep phrases with 20 to 300 papers in the first-appearance window, freeze and hash the frame before any later data are read, and ground each concept with a classifier.`,
  out:`<span class="chip">${esc(titleCase(ex.phrase))}</span>, first year ${ex.F}, origin subfield <em>${esc(ex.origin_subfield)}</em>; ${ex.early_volume} papers in ${ex.F} to ${ex.F+2} (${earlyYears}); ${fmtInt(ex.n_works)} works by 2024.`,
  why:`The frame is outcome-blind: it was fixed before anyone could see which concepts later spread, so the pool is not selected on success.`,chart:'counts'},
 {name:'Host entry',short:['Host','entry'],
  in:`Every paper of the concept, tagged with its OpenAlex subfield and its co-occurring keyword terms.`,
  do:`Find the first year the concept appears in each non-origin subfield. Count it as a host-entry event only if at least five partner terms co-occur.`,
  out:`Entry into <span class="chip">${esc(ex.host)}</span> in <span class="chip">${ex.entry_year}</span>, the concept's own first year, with <span class="chip">${ex.n_partners}</span> distinct partner terms across ${ex.n_entry_papers} entry-year papers.`,
  why:`OpenAlex files the topic Quantum Information and Cryptography under its Artificial Intelligence subfield, which is broader than the colloquial meaning of AI. The entry is the unit of analysis, so one concept contributes one row per host.`},
 {name:'Host-vocabulary share',short:['Host','share'],
  in:`The ${ex.n_partners} partner terms, and for each one its pre-entry publication counts by subfield and time block.`,
  do:`For each partner, take the share of its pre-entry papers that sit in the host subfield. Average across partners, weighting each by the association strength of its co-occurrence edge.`,
  out:`Host-vocabulary share <span class="chip">${fmt(ex.host_share,3)}</span>. The Screen-fold SD of the share is ${fmt(sdS,3)}, so this entry is about ${fmt(ex.host_share/sdS,1)} SD of share above zero.`,
  why:`A share near zero means the concept arrives speaking only its origin's vocabulary; a higher share means its first partners are words the host already uses.`},
 {name:'Co-transfer',short:['Co-','transfer'],
  in:`The same partners, and the concept's companion terms in its origin subfield over the five years before entry (${ex.entry_year-5} to ${ex.entry_year-1}).`,
  do:`Count the fraction of entry partners that were origin companions.`,
  out:`Co-transfer <span class="chip">${fmt(ex.co_transfer,2)}</span>: none of the partners came along from the origin package.`,
  why:`Co-transfer is the competing explanation: a concept that travels with its own toolkit might take root regardless of host fit. It enters every model as a second regressor.`},
 {name:'Newcomer outcome',short:['Newcomer','outcome'],
  in:`Host-subfield papers carrying the concept in the five years after entry (${ex.entry_year+1} to ${ex.entry_year+5}).`,
  do:`Keep only papers by author-disjoint newcomers: authors with no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors.`,
  out:`<span class="chip">${ex.newcomer_papers}</span> newcomer papers (${ex.Y_all} host papers in all). The entry also meets the binary establishment rule, so it counts as rooted.`,
  why:`Counting only newcomers separates uptake by the host community from the concept's original authors publishing in a new venue.`},
 {name:'PPML model',short:['PPML','model'],
  in:`All 1,544 Screen entries retained by the co-primary model, with share, co-transfer and controls.`,
  do:`Fit PPML with concept, entry-year and host fixed effects and concept-clustered errors. Separately, the run recorded grouped out-of-fold predictions from a controls-only model and from one that adds share and co-transfer.`,
  out:`Screen co-primary IRR per SD <span class="chip">${fr('scr_co','A').est_s}</span>. For this entry: controls-only prediction <span class="chip">${fmt(ex.pred_baseline,1)}</span>, with share and co-transfer <span class="chip">${fmt(ex.pred_method,1)}</span>, observed <span class="chip">${ex.newcomer_papers}</span>.`,
  why:`Adding host-vocabulary share moves this entry's prediction toward what happened, though both models still under-predict it.`,chart:'pred'}
];
let stage=0;
function drawPipe(){
  const host=$('#c-pipe');host.innerHTML='';const W=Math.max(280,host.clientWidth);const n=STAGES.length;const perRow=W<620?3:6;const rowsN=Math.ceil(n/perRow);
  const gap=W<620?10:14;const bw=(W-gap*(perRow-1))/perRow,bh=54,rh=bh+22;
  const svg=el('svg',{width:W,height:rowsN*rh,role:'group','aria-label':'Pipeline with six stages'},host);
  STAGES.forEach((s,i)=>{const r=Math.floor(i/perRow),c=i%perRow;const x=c*(bw+gap),y=r*rh+4;const cur=i===stage,done=i<stage;
    const g=el('g',{class:'node',tabindex:0,role:'button','aria-label':`Stage ${i+1}: ${s.name}`},svg);if(cur)g.setAttribute('aria-current','step');
    el('rect',{x:x+1,y,width:bw-2,height:bh,rx:8,fill:cur?C.accent:(done?'#e6eef8':'#fff'),stroke:cur?C.accent:'#9aa0a8','stroke-width':1.5},g);
    const fs=bw<100?12:13;
    tx(g,x+bw/2,y+22,fit(`${i+1}. ${s.short[0]}`,fs,700,bw-10),{'text-anchor':'middle','font-size':fs,'font-weight':700,fill:cur?'#fff':C.ink});
    tx(g,x+bw/2,y+40,fit(s.short[1],fs,400,bw-10),{'text-anchor':'middle','font-size':fs,fill:cur?'#fff':C.ink2});
    if(c<perRow-1&&i<n-1){el('path',{d:`M${x+bw-1} ${y+bh/2}l${gap} 0`,stroke:'#9aa0a8','stroke-width':1.5},svg);}
    g.addEventListener('click',()=>{setStage(i);});g.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();setStage(i);}});
  });
}
function drawStageChart(){
  const host=$('#c-stage');host.innerHTML='';const s=STAGES[stage];
  if(s.chart==='counts'){
    const rows=yrs.filter(y=>y>=ex.F-1).map(y=>({label:String(y),est:ex.counts_by_year[y],color:(y>=ex.F&&y<=ex.F+2)?C.accent:C.light,tip:`<b>${y}</b><br>${ex.counts_by_year[y]} papers`,aria:`${y}: ${ex.counts_by_year[y]} papers`}));
    const h4=document.createElement('p');h4.className='note';h4.textContent='Papers per year for this concept (OpenAlex, verified). Blue: the first-appearance window used by the inclusion rule.';host.appendChild(h4);
    const d=document.createElement('div');host.appendChild(d);
    hchart(d,{rows,bars:true,barBase:0,domain:[0,Math.max(...rows.map(r=>r.est))*1.05],xTitle:'Papers per year',rowH:22,aria:'Papers per year'});
  } else if(s.chart==='pred'){
    const d=document.createElement('div');host.appendChild(d);
    const rows=[{label:'Controls-only model',est:ex.pred_baseline,color:C.muted},{label:'+ share and co-transfer',est:ex.pred_method,color:C.accent},{label:'Observed',est:ex.newcomer_papers,color:C.ink}].map(r=>Object.assign(r,{tip:`<b>${r.label}</b><br>${fmt(r.est,1)} newcomer papers`,aria:`${r.label}: ${fmt(r.est,1)} newcomer papers`}));
    hchart(d,{rows,bars:true,barBase:0,domain:[0,Math.max(...rows.map(r=>r.est))*1.08],xTitle:'Newcomer papers in the five years after entry',aria:'Predicted and observed newcomer papers'});
  }
}
function setStage(i,announce=true){
  stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i));const s=STAGES[stage];
  $('#s-title').textContent=`Stage ${stage+1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${s.name}`;
  $('#s-in').innerHTML=s.in;$('#s-do').innerHTML=s.do;$('#s-out').innerHTML=s.out;$('#s-why').innerHTML='<strong>Why:</strong> '+s.why;
  $('#s-prev').disabled=stage===0;$('#s-next').disabled=stage===STAGES.length-1;$('#s-count').textContent=`Stage ${stage+1} of ${STAGES.length}`;
  if(announce)$('#s-live').textContent=`Stage ${stage+1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${s.name}`;
  drawPipe();drawStageChart();
}
$('#s-prev').addEventListener('click',()=>setStage(stage-1));$('#s-next').addEventListener('click',()=>setStage(stage+1));
$('#stepper').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.closest('input,select'))return;if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();setStage(stage+1);}else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();setStage(stage-1);}});

/* ================= BINNED VIEW ================= */
fillFold($('#b-fold'),true);
function quantileGroups(rows,k){const s=rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.share-b.share||a.i-b.i);const out=[];for(let g=0;g<k;g++){const a=Math.floor(g*s.length/k),b=Math.floor((g+1)*s.length/k);out.push(s.slice(a,b));}return out;}
function drawBins(){
  const f=+$('#b-fold').value,k=+$('#b-bins').value,m=radio('b-metric');const rows=byFold[f];
  const val=g=>m==='mean'?g.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.y,0)/g.length:g.filter(r=>r.y>=1).length/g.length;
  const groups=quantileGroups(rows,k);const all=val(rows);
  const name=k===4?'Quartile':(k===5?'Quintile':'Decile');
  const vf=v=>m==='mean'?fmt(v,2):pct(v,1);
  const R=groups.map((g,i)=>{const v=val(g);const lo=g[0].share,hi=g[g.length-1].share;return{label:`${name} ${i+1}`,sub:`share ${fmt(lo,3)} to ${fmt(hi,3)}`,est:v,color:C.accent,
    tip:`<b>${name} ${i+1} of ${k}</b><br>Host-vocabulary share ${fmt(lo,3)} to ${fmt(hi,3)}<br>${fmtInt(g.length)} entries<br>${m==='mean'?'Mean newcomer papers':'Share with any newcomer uptake'}: ${vf(v)}`,aria:`${name} ${i+1}, share ${fmt(lo,3)} to ${fmt(hi,3)}, ${vf(v)}`};});
  const mx=Math.max(...R.map(r=>r.est),all)*1.08;
  hchart($('#c-bins'),{rows:R,bars:true,barBase:0,domain:[0,mx],nullLine:all,xTitle:m==='mean'?'Mean newcomer papers per entry':'Share of entries with any newcomer uptake',tickFmt:m==='mean'?(v=>String(+v.toFixed(2))):(v=>Math.round(v*100)+'%'),aria:'Outcome by host-vocabulary share group'});
  const a=R[0].est,b=R[R.length-1].est;
  $('#t-bins').textContent=`${FOLDS[f]}: entries in the top ${name.toLowerCase()} of host-vocabulary share ${m==='mean'?'average '+vf(b)+' newcomer papers':'attract any newcomer '+vf(b)+' of the time'}, against ${vf(a)} in the bottom ${name.toLowerCase()} (fold average ${vf(all)}). ${b>a?'The raw gradient points the same way as the model.':'The raw gradient does not point the same way as the model here.'}`;
}
['#b-fold','#b-bins'].forEach(s=>$(s).addEventListener('change',drawBins));document.querySelectorAll('input[name="b-metric"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener('change',drawBins));

/* ================= ITEM BROWSER ================= */
fillFold($('#r-fold'),true);
let shown=40,selected=null,list=[];
const pctRank={};[0,1,2].forEach(f=>{const s=byFold[f].map(r=>r.share).sort((a,b)=>a-b);pctRank[f]=v=>{let lo=0,hi=s.length;while(lo<hi){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(s[m]<v)lo=m+1;else hi=m;}return lo/s.length;};});
function predLabels(f){return f===1?['Controls-only model','Screen-fitted model with share and co-transfer']:['Controls-only model (out-of-fold)','With share and co-transfer (out-of-fold)'];}
function buildList(){
  const f=+$('#r-fold').value,q=$('#r-q').value.trim().toLowerCase(),flt=$('#r-filter').value,so=$('#r-sort').value;
  list=byFold[f].filter(r=>(!q||r.concept.toLowerCase().includes(q)||r.host.toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(flt==='all'||(flt==='any'&&r.y>=1)||(flt==='none'&&r.y===0)||(flt==='est'&&r.est===1)));
  const cmp={share:(a,b)=>b.share-a.share,y:(a,b)=>b.y-a.y||b.share-a.share,resid:(a,b)=>(b.y-b.pm)-(a.y-a.pm),year:(a,b)=>a.year-b.year||b.share-a.share}[so];
  list.sort(cmp);
  const estNote=(flt==='est'&&f===1)?' The held-out records carry no establishment flag, so this filter is empty there.':'';
  $('#r-count').textContent=`${fmtInt(list.length)} of ${fmtInt(byFold[f].length)} ${FOLDS[f]} entries match.${estNote}`;
}
function renderTable(){
  const tb=$('#r-body');tb.innerHTML='';
  list.slice(0,shown).forEach(r=>{const tr=document.createElement('tr');if(selected&&selected.i===r.i)tr.className='sel';
    const td=document.createElement('td');const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='rowbtn';b.type='button';b.textContent=titleCase(r.concept);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',selected&&selected.i===r.i?'true':'false');b.addEventListener('click',()=>{select(r);});td.appendChild(b);tr.appendChild(td);
    [r.host,r.year,fmt(r.share,3),r.y].forEach((v,j)=>{const c=document.createElement('td');c.textContent=v;if(j>0)c.className='num';tr.appendChild(c);});tb.appendChild(tr);});
  $('#r-more').hidden=list.length<=shown;
}
function select(r,scroll){selected=r;renderTable();renderDetail();if(scroll)$('#h-browser').scrollIntoView();}
function renderDetail(){
  const r=selected;if(!r){$('#d-title').textContent='No entry selected';return;}
  const f=r.fold;const pl=predLabels(f);
  $('#d-title').textContent=`${titleCase(r.concept)} → ${r.host}, ${r.year} (${FOLDS[f]})`;
  const kv=[['Host-vocabulary share',`${fmt(r.share,3)} (${Math.round(100*pctRank[f](r.share))}th percentile of the fold)`],['Co-transfer',fmt(r.ct,2)],['Distinct partner terms',r.np>=0?r.np:'not recorded in this file'],['Origin field group',r.fg],['Newcomer papers, next five years',r.y],['Established',r.est<0?'not recorded for held-out':(r.est?'yes':'no')]];
  $('#d-kv').innerHTML=kv.map(([k,v])=>`<dt>${esc(k)}</dt><dd>${esc(v)}</dd>`).join('');
  const rows=[{label:pl[0],est:r.pb,color:C.muted},{label:pl[1],est:r.pm,color:C.accent},{label:'Observed',est:r.y,color:C.ink}].map(x=>Object.assign(x,{tip:`<b>${esc(x.label)}</b><br>${fmt(x.est,2)} newcomer papers`,aria:`${x.label}: ${fmt(x.est,2)} newcomer papers`}));
  hchart($('#c-pred'),{rows,bars:true,barBase:0,domain:[0,Math.max(1,...rows.map(x=>x.est))*1.08],xTitle:'Newcomer papers in the five years after entry',aria:'Predicted and observed newcomer papers'});
  drawSiblings();
  const dm=r.pm-r.pb;const closer=Math.abs(r.y-r.pm)<Math.abs(r.y-r.pb);
  $('#t-detail').textContent=`Adding host-vocabulary share and co-transfer moves the prediction ${dm>=0?'up':'down'} by ${fmt(Math.abs(dm),2)} to ${fmt(r.pm,2)}; ${r.y} newcomer papers were observed, so the fuller model is ${closer?'closer to':'further from'} what happened for this entry.`;
}
function drawSiblings(){
  const r=selected;const host=$('#c-sib');host.innerHTML='';const sib=byFold[r.fold].filter(s=>s.concept===r.concept);
  $('#d-sib-title').textContent=`All ${sib.length} ${sib.length===1?'entry':'entries'} of this concept in the ${FOLDS[r.fold]} fold`;
  const W=Math.max(280,host.clientWidth);const maxY=Math.max(1,...sib.map(s=>s.y));const yt=niceTicks(0,maxY,4);const ymax=Math.max(maxY,yt[yt.length-1]);
  const tickW=Math.max(...yt.map(t=>tw(String(t),12)));const titleH=16;const x0=titleH+8+tickW+8,x1=W-12,top=10,H=200,y1=top+H;
  const maxS=Math.max(0.02,...sib.map(s=>s.share));const xt=niceTicks(0,maxS,5);const xmax=Math.max(maxS,xt[xt.length-1]);
  const sx=v=>x0+v/xmax*(x1-x0),sy=v=>y1-v/ymax*H;
  const svg=el('svg',{width:W,height:y1+50,role:'group','aria-label':'Entries of this concept: share against newcomer papers'},host);
  let xticks=xt;const xw=Math.max(...xt.map(t=>tw(fmt(t,3),12)))+12;while(xticks.length>2&&(sx(xticks[1])-sx(xticks[0]))<xw)xticks=xticks.filter((t,i)=>i%2===0);
  yt.forEach(t=>{el('line',{x1:x0,x2:x1,y1:sy(t),y2:sy(t),stroke:C.grid},svg);tx(svg,x0-6,sy(t)+4,String(t),{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'end',fill:C.ink2});});
  xticks.forEach(t=>{tx(svg,sx(t),y1+16,fmt(t,3),{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle',fill:C.ink2});});
  el('line',{x1:x0,x2:x1,y1:y1,y2:y1,stroke:'#b9b9b2'},svg);
  tx(svg,(x0+x1)/2,y1+38,'Host-vocabulary share',{'font-size':13,'text-anchor':'middle',fill:C.ink2});
  tx(svg,0,0,'Newcomer papers',{'font-size':13,'text-anchor':'middle',fill:C.ink2,transform:`translate(${titleH-3},${top+H/2}) rotate(-90)`});
  sib.slice().sort((a,b)=>(a.i===r.i)-(b.i===r.i)).forEach(s=>{const g=el('g',{},svg);const on=s.i===r.i;el('circle',{class:'hit',cx:sx(s.share),cy:sy(s.y),r:12,fill:'transparent'},g);
    el('circle',{cx:sx(s.share),cy:sy(s.y),r:on?7:5.5,fill:on?C.accent:C.light,stroke:on?C.ink:'#7d848d','stroke-width':on?1.5:1},g);
    bindMark(g,`<b>${esc(s.host)}, ${s.year}</b><br>Share ${fmt(s.share,3)} · co-transfer ${fmt(s.ct,2)}<br>${s.y} newcomer papers${on?'<br>(selected)':''}`,`${s.host} ${s.year}: share ${fmt(s.share,3)}, ${s.y} newcomer papers`,on?null:()=>select(s));});
}
['#r-fold','#r-filter','#r-sort'].forEach(s=>$(s).addEventListener('change',()=>{shown=40;buildList();renderTable();}));
$('#r-q').addEventListener('input',()=>{shown=40;buildList();renderTable();});
$('#r-more').addEventListener('click',()=>{shown+=40;renderTable();});

/* ================= MARGINS ================= */
let mTab='ext';
function drawMargins(){
  const rows=MG.folds.map(f=>{const e=mTab==='ext';const v=e?f.ext:f.int,ci=e?f.ext_ci:f.int_ci;const s=e?`${fmt(v,2)} pp [${fmt(ci[0],2)}, ${fmt(ci[1],2)}]`:`${fmt(v,3)} [${fmt(ci[0],3)}, ${fmt(ci[1],3)}]`;
    return{label:f.fold,sub:s,est:v,lo:ci[0],hi:ci[1],color:C.accent,tip:`<b>${f.fold}</b><br>${e?'Effect on P(any uptake)':'IRR per SD given uptake'}: ${s}<br>N ${fmtInt(e?f.N_ext:f.N_int)}, G ${e?f.G_ext:f.G_int}${e?'<br>Base rate '+pct(f.base_rate,0):''}`,aria:`${f.fold}: ${s}`};});
  const iv=MG.ivw;const e=mTab==='ext';const v=e?iv.ext:iv.int,ci=e?iv.ext_ci:iv.int_ci;const s=e?`${fmt(v,2)} pp [${fmt(ci[0],2)}, ${fmt(ci[1],2)}]`:`${fmt(v,3)} [${fmt(ci[0],3)}, ${fmt(ci[1],3)}]`;
  rows.push({label:'IVW pooled',sub:s,est:v,lo:ci[0],hi:ci[1],color:C.amber,shape:'diamond',bold:true,tip:`<b>IVW pooled</b><br>${s}`,aria:`IVW pooled: ${s}`});
  if(e)hchart($('#c-margins'),{rows,domain:extent(rows.flatMap(r=>[r.lo,r.hi]),0.08,0),nullLine:0,xTitle:'Effect on P(any newcomer uptake), percentage points per SD',aria:'Extensive margin estimates'});
  else hchart($('#c-margins'),{rows,scale:'log',domain:[0.9,1.6],nullLine:1,xTitle:'IRR per SD given uptake (log scale)',aria:'Intensive margin estimates',tickFmt:v=>String(v)});
  const all=MG.folds.every(f=>(e?f.ext_ci[0]>0:f.int_ci[0]>1));
  $('#t-margins').textContent=e?`Extensive margin: one SD more host vocabulary raises the chance that any newcomer uptake starts by ${fmt(iv.ext,2)} percentage points (95% CI ${fmt(iv.ext_ci[0],2)} to ${fmt(iv.ext_ci[1],2)}); ${all?'every fold interval excludes zero':'not every fold interval excludes zero'}. This margin carries ${Math.round(100*iv.ext_share)}% of the total effect (95% CI ${Math.round(100*iv.ext_share_ci[0])}% to ${Math.round(100*iv.ext_share_ci[1])}%).`
    :`Intensive margin: once uptake has started, one SD more host vocabulary goes with an IRR of ${fmt(iv.int,3)} (95% CI ${fmt(iv.int_ci[0],3)} to ${fmt(iv.int_ci[1],3)}); ${all?'every fold interval excludes 1':'not every fold interval excludes 1'}. This margin carries the remaining ${100-Math.round(100*iv.ext_share)}% of the effect.`;
}
function tabs(container,onSel){const ts=[...container.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')];ts.forEach((t,i)=>{t.addEventListener('click',()=>act(i));t.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{let j=null;if(e.key==='ArrowRight')j=(i+1)%ts.length;else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')j=(i-1+ts.length)%ts.length;else if(e.key==='Home')j=0;else if(e.key==='End')j=ts.length-1;if(j!=null){e.preventDefault();act(j);ts[j].focus();}});});
  function act(i){ts.forEach((t,j)=>{t.setAttribute('aria-selected',j===i?'true':'false');t.tabIndex=j===i?0:-1;});onSel(ts[i],i);}}
tabs($('#m-tabs'),t=>{mTab=t.dataset.v;$('#m-panel').setAttribute('aria-labelledby',t.id);drawMargins();});

/* ================= CASES ================= */
const caseNames=[...new Set(CA.map(c=>c.concept))];let kIdx=0;
caseNames.forEach((n,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.setAttribute('role','tab');b.type='button';b.id='k-tab-'+i;b.setAttribute('aria-controls','k-panel');b.setAttribute('aria-selected',i===0?'true':'false');b.tabIndex=i===0?0:-1;b.textContent=titleCase(n).replace('Einstein Podolsky Rosen','EPR');$('#k-tabs').appendChild(b);});
tabs($('#k-tabs'),(t,i)=>{kIdx=i;$('#k-panel').setAttribute('aria-labelledby',t.id);drawCases();});
function drawCases(){
  const name=caseNames[kIdx],all=$('#k-all').checked;
  const ents=CA.filter(c=>c.concept===name&&(all||c.in_coprimary));const withS=ents.filter(c=>c.share!=null).sort((a,b)=>b.share-a.share);const noS=ents.length-withS.length;
  const non=withS.filter(c=>!c.rooted);const mean=non.length?non.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.share,0)/non.length:null;
  const rows=withS.map(c=>({label:`${c.host} ${c.year}`,est:c.share,color:c.rooted?C.green:C.light,tip:`<b>${esc(c.host)}, ${c.year}</b><br>Host-vocabulary share ${fmt(c.share,3)}<br>Co-transfer ${fmt(c.ct,2)}<br>${c.newcomers} newcomer papers<br>${c.rooted?'Rooted':'Not rooted'}${c.in_coprimary?'':'<br>Outside the co-primary sample'}`,aria:`${c.host} ${c.year}: share ${fmt(c.share,3)}, ${c.rooted?'rooted':'not rooted'}`}));
  const mx=Math.max(0.02,...rows.map(r=>r.est))*1.1;
  hchart($('#c-cases'),{rows,bars:true,barBase:0,domain:[0,mx],nullLine:mean,xTitle:'Host-vocabulary share (fraction)',rowH:26,aria:'Host entries of '+name,tickFmt:v=>String(+v.toFixed(3))});
  const rooted=withS.filter(c=>c.rooted);const type=ents[0].type.startsWith('broad')?'broad from the start':'localised';
  let t=`${titleCase(name)} (${type}): ${ents.length} ${all?'recorded':'co-primary'} ${ents.length===1?'entry':'entries'}, ${rooted.length} rooted.`;
  if(rooted.length&&non.length){const r=rooted[0];const above=non.every(c=>c.share<r.share);t+=` The rooted entry (${r.host} ${r.year}, share ${fmt(r.share,3)}, ${r.newcomers} newcomer papers) sits against a non-rooted mean of ${fmt(mean,3)}, and its share is ${above?'higher than every':'not higher than every'} non-rooted entry.`;}
  else if(rooted.length){const r=rooted[0];t+=` Its one entry is rooted (share ${fmt(r.share,3)}, ${r.newcomers} newcomer papers), so there is no within-concept contrast.`;}
  else if(non.length){const top=withS[0];t+=` None took root; mean share ${fmt(mean,3)}. The highest-share entry, ${top.host} at ${fmt(top.share,3)}, did not take root either.`;}
  if(noS)t+=` ${noS} ${noS===1?'entry has':'entries have'} no recorded share and ${noS===1?'is':'are'} not drawn.`;
  $('#t-cases').textContent=t;
}
$('#k-all').addEventListener('change',drawCases);

/* ================= WHAT-IF ================= */
fillFold($('#w-fold'),true);
function drawWhatIf(){
  const f=+$('#w-fold').value,th=+$('#w-th').value,m=radio('w-metric');$('#w-thv').textContent=fmt(th,3);
  const rows=byFold[f];const lo=rows.filter(r=>r.share<th),hi=rows.filter(r=>r.share>=th);
  const st=g=>g.length?{n:g.length,any:g.filter(r=>r.y>=1).length/g.length,mean:g.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.y,0)/g.length,est:f===1?null:g.filter(r=>r.est===1).length/g.length}:{n:0,any:null,mean:null,est:null};
  const a=st(lo),b=st(hi);
  const cell=(k,v)=>`<div class="stat"><div class="v">${v}</div><div class="k">${k}</div></div>`;
  $('#w-stats').innerHTML=cell('Entries below / at or above',`${fmtInt(a.n)} / ${fmtInt(b.n)}`)+cell('Any newcomer uptake, below / above',`${a.any==null?'n/a':pct(a.any)} / ${b.any==null?'n/a':pct(b.any)}`)+cell('Mean newcomer papers, below / above',`${a.mean==null?'n/a':fmt(a.mean,2)} / ${b.mean==null?'n/a':fmt(b.mean,2)}`)+cell('Established, below / above',f===1?'not recorded':`${a.est==null?'n/a':pct(a.est)} / ${b.est==null?'n/a':pct(b.est)}`);
  const vf=v=>v==null?'n/a':(m==='any'?pct(v,1):fmt(v,2));
  const R=[{label:`Below ${fmt(th,3)}`,sub:`${fmtInt(a.n)} entries`,est:a[m]||0,color:C.light,tip:`<b>Share below ${fmt(th,3)}</b><br>${fmtInt(a.n)} entries<br>${m==='any'?'Any uptake':'Mean newcomer papers'}: ${vf(a[m])}`,aria:`Below threshold: ${vf(a[m])}`},
           {label:`At or above ${fmt(th,3)}`,sub:`${fmtInt(b.n)} entries`,est:b[m]||0,color:C.accent,tip:`<b>Share at or above ${fmt(th,3)}</b><br>${fmtInt(b.n)} entries<br>${m==='any'?'Any uptake':'Mean newcomer papers'}: ${vf(b[m])}`,aria:`At or above threshold: ${vf(b[m])}`}];
  const mx=m==='any'?1:Math.max(1,...R.map(r=>r.est))*1.1;
  hchart($('#c-whatif'),{rows:R,bars:true,barBase:0,domain:[0,mx],xTitle:m==='any'?'Share of entries with any newcomer uptake':'Mean newcomer papers per entry',tickFmt:m==='any'?(v=>Math.round(v*100)+'%'):(v=>String(+v.toFixed(2))),aria:'Threshold comparison'});
  let t;
  if(!a.n||!b.n)t=`At ${fmt(th,3)} every ${FOLDS[f]} entry falls on one side, so there is nothing to compare. Move the threshold.`;
  else t=`${FOLDS[f]}: at a cut-off of ${fmt(th,3)}, ${fmtInt(b.n)} entries (${pct(b.n/rows.length)}) count as host-leaning. ${pct(b.any)} of them drew any newcomer, against ${pct(a.any)} below the line; they averaged ${fmt(b.mean,2)} newcomer papers against ${fmt(a.mean,2)}.`;
  $('#t-whatif').textContent=t;
}
['#w-fold'].forEach(s=>$(s).addEventListener('change',drawWhatIf));$('#w-th').addEventListener('input',drawWhatIf);document.querySelectorAll('input[name="w-metric"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener('change',drawWhatIf));

/* ================= FAILURES ================= */
fillFold($('#x-fold'),true);
function quant(arr,q){const s=arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b);return s[Math.min(s.length-1,Math.floor(q*s.length))];}
function drawFails(){
  const f=+$('#x-fold').value,k=radio('x-kind');const rows=byFold[f];const shares=rows.map(r=>r.share);
  let sel,desc,ref,refDesc;
  if(k==='hinone'){const q9=quant(shares,0.9);const top=rows.filter(r=>r.share>=q9);sel=top.filter(r=>r.y===0).sort((a,b)=>b.share-a.share);ref=top;desc=`top-decile entries (share ${fmt(q9,3)} or more) with no newcomer paper`;refDesc='top-decile entries';}
  else{const med=quant(shares,0.5);const bot=rows.filter(r=>r.share<med);sel=bot.filter(r=>r.y>=10).sort((a,b)=>b.y-a.y);ref=bot;desc=`bottom-half entries (share below ${fmt(med,3)}) with 10 or more newcomer papers`;refDesc='bottom-half entries';}
  const cell=(kk,v)=>`<div class="stat"><div class="v">${v}</div><div class="k">${kk}</div></div>`;
  $('#x-stats').innerHTML=cell(cap(refDesc),fmtInt(ref.length))+cell('Exceptions',fmtInt(sel.length))+cell('Exception rate',pct(sel.length/ref.length,1));
  const ul=$('#x-list');ul.innerHTML='';
  sel.slice(0,8).forEach(r=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.innerHTML=`<span><strong>${esc(titleCase(r.concept))}</strong> → ${esc(r.host)}, ${r.year}</span><span class="note">share ${fmt(r.share,3)} · co-transfer ${fmt(r.ct,2)} · ${r.y} newcomer papers</span>`;const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='b';b.type='button';b.textContent='Open in browser';b.addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#r-fold').value=f;$('#r-q').value='';$('#r-filter').value='all';shown=40;buildList();const idx=list.findIndex(x=>x.i===r.i);if(idx>=shown)shown=idx+1;select(r,true);});li.appendChild(b);ul.appendChild(li);});
  $('#t-fails').textContent=`${FOLDS[f]}: ${fmtInt(sel.length)} of ${fmtInt(ref.length)} ${refDesc} (${pct(sel.length/ref.length,1)}) are ${k==='hinone'?'host-leaning entries that drew no newcomer at all':'origin-leaning entries that still drew 10 or more newcomer papers'}. The share shifts the odds; it does not decide single entries.${sel.length>8?' The list shows the first 8.':''}`;
}
$('#x-fold').addEventListener('change',drawFails);document.querySelectorAll('input[name="x-kind"]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener('change',drawFails));

/* ================= CLOSURE ================= */
function drawClosure(){
  const est=radio('c-est'),fold=radio('c-fold');
  const rows=['closure','closure_resT','closure_persist','constraint'].map(m=>{const r=CL.rows.find(x=>x.measure===m&&x.estimator===est&&x.fold===fold);const d=CL.decisions[m];
    const col=m==='constraint'?C.amber:(d.decision==='CONFIRMED'?C.accent:C.muted);
    const holm=(fold==='ho'&&m!=='constraint')?` · Holm p ${fmt(d.holm,3)}`:'';
    return{label:r.label,sub:`${r.est_s} [${r.lo_s}, ${r.hi_s}]${holm}`,est:r.est,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:col,
      tip:`<b>${r.label}</b><br>${est==='pp'?'Pooled-panel coefficient':'Event-study standardised mean difference'}, ${fold==='ho'?'held-out':'screen'}<br>${r.est_s}, 95% CI ${r.lo_s} to ${r.hi_s}<br>Registry value ${r.est3} [${r.lo3}, ${r.hi3}]${fold==='ho'&&m!=='constraint'?'<br>Holm p (panel) '+fmt(d.holm,3)+', '+d.decision.toLowerCase():''}`,aria:`${r.label}: ${r.est_s}, CI ${r.lo_s} to ${r.hi_s}`};});

These are raw averages with no fixed effects or controls, so they describe the data and are not the paper's estimate. The Screen fold holds all 1,740 recorded entries with at least five partners (the co-primary model keeps 1,544); Held-out holds 1,097 (model keeps 972); MeSH holds 2,249 (model keeps 2,171).</p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-browser\">What happened to one entry?</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">Pick any recorded host entry. The panel puts its inputs beside two model predictions of its newcomer papers, one from the controls-only model and one with host-vocabulary share and co-transfer added, and beside what was observed.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label>Fold <select id=\"r-fold\"></select></label>\n      <label>Search <input type=\"search\" id=\"r-q\" placeholder=\"concept or host subfield\" aria-describedby=\"r-count\"></label>\n      <label>Show <select id=\"r-filter\">\n        <option value=\"all\">All entries</option>\n        <option value=\"any\">Any newcomer uptake</option>\n        <option value=\"none\">No newcomer uptake</option>\n        <option value=\"est\">Established (Screen and MeSH only)</option>\n low</option>\n        <option value=\"resid\">Observed minus predicted, high to low</option>\n        <option value=\"year\">Entry year</option>\n      </select></label>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"r-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"tablewrap\">\n          <table>\n            <caption class=\"sr\">Recorded host-entry events</caption>\n            <thead><tr><th scope=\"col\">Concept</th><th scope=\"col\">Host subfield</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Year</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Share</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Newcomer papers</th></tr></thead>\n            <tbody id=\"r-body\"></tbody>\n          </table>\n        </div>\n        <p><button class=\"b\" id=\"r-more\" type=\"button\">Show 40 more</button></p>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"r-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\">\n        <h4 id=\"d-title\"></h4>\n        <dl class=\"kv\" id=\"d-kv\"></dl>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-pred\"></div>\n        <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--muted)\"></span>Controls-only model</li><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>With host-vocabulary share and co-transfer</li><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--ink)\"></span>Observed</li></ul>\n        <h4 style=\"margin-top:16px\" id=\"d-sib-title\">Other entries of this concept in this fold</h4>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-sib\"></div>\n        <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Selected entry</li><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:#b8bec6\"></span>Other entries (click to open)</li></ul>\n        <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-detail\"></p>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"note\">Predictions: Screen and MeSH use grouped out-of-fold Poisson predictions recorded by the run (experiment 7, experiment 9). Held-out uses the Screen-fitted models applied to the sealed fold (evaluation 2). They are descriptive checks, not the inferential test.</p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-margins\">Does host vocabulary start uptake, or make it larger?</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">The effect splits into an <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"extensive\">extensive margin</button> (whether any newcomer uptake starts) and an <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"intensive\">intensive margin</button> (how much, once it has started). This decomposition was frozen after the confirmation and is exploratory.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Margin\" id=\"m-tabs\">\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"m-tab-ext\" aria-selected=\"true\" aria-controls=\"m-panel\" data-v=\"ext\" type=\"button\">Extensive margin</button>\n      <button role=\"tab\" id=\"m-tab-int\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"m-panel\" data-v=\"int\" tabindex=\"-1\" type=\"button\">Intensive margin</button>\n    </div>\n    <div id=\"m-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"m-tab-ext\">\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-margins\"></div>\n      <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Per fold</li><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--amber);transform:rotate(45deg)\"></span>IVW pooled</li><li><span class=\"sw dash\"></span>No effect</li></ul>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-margins\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Source: evaluation 6, <code>results/k1_decomposition.json</code>.</p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-cases\">What does the gradient look like inside one concept?</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">Four medoid concepts from the typology. Each bar is one host entry, sorted by host-vocabulary share; green bars are entries that took root.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Case concept\" id=\"k-tabs\"></div>\n    <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"k-all\"> Include entries outside the co-primary sample</label>\n    <div id=\"k-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\">\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-cases\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--green)\"></span>Rooted entry</li><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:#b8bec6\"></span>Not rooted</li><li><span class=\"sw dash\"></span>Mean share of non-rooted entries</li></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-cases\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Source: evaluation 4, <code>eval_out.json</code> dataset <code>case_entries</code> (33 entries). The panels are descriptive, so no intervals are drawn.</p>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it: call an entry host-leaning above a threshold</h2>\n  <p class=\"q\">The model uses the share as a continuous number. What if you split entries at a cut-off instead? Drag the threshold and the page recomputes, from the recorded entries, how often each side attracted any newcomer and how many newcomer papers it drew.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label>Fold <select id=\"w-fold\"></select></label>\n      <label for=\"w-th\">Threshold on host-vocabulary share</label>\n      <input type=\"range\" id=\"w-th\" min=\"0\" max=\"0.2\" step=\"0.005\" value=\"0.05\" aria-describedby=\"w-thv\">\n      <output id=\"w-thv\" for=\"w-th\"></output>\n      <fieldset>\n        <legend>Bar shows</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Bar shows\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"w-metric\" value=\"any\" checked><span>Share with any uptake</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"w-metric\" value=\"mean\"><span>Mean newcomer papers</span></label>\n        </div>\n      </fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"stats\" id=\"w-stats\"></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-whatif\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:#b8bec6\"></span>Below the threshold</li><li><span class=\"sw sq\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>At or above the threshold</li></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-whatif\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Raw comparison with no controls. The paper's model does not use a cut-off: only 1.1% of partner tags have a host share above 50%, which is why the continuous share is primary, and binary nativeness cut-offs at 0.5 and 0.7 are null. A PPML with concept, year and host fixed effects cannot be refitted honestly in a browser, so this view sweeps a threshold over the recorded outcomes instead.</p>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n  <h3>Which entries go against the gradient?</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">A graded effect leaves plenty of exceptions. Pick a kind of exception and a fold; the counts come from the recorded entries.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label>Fold <select id=\"x-fold\"></select></label>\n      <fieldset>\n        <legend>Exception</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Exception\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"x-kind\" value=\"hinone\" checked><span>Top-decile share, no uptake</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"x-kind\" value=\"lohigh\"><span>Bottom-half share, 10+ newcomer papers</span></label>\n        </div>\n      </fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"stats\" id=\"x-stats\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"faillist\" id=\"x-list\"></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-fails\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3>The emergence question returned dead</h3>\n  <p class=\"q\">The paper's second question (RQ1) asked whether network structure before take-off marks the concepts that later show <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"eup\">sustained uptake</button>. The held-out test, under its frozen kill rule, returned <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"r1dead\">R1_DEAD</button>. Switch estimator and fold to see which closure rows survive.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset>\n        <legend>Estimator</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Estimator\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"c-est\" value=\"pp\" checked><span>Pooled panel</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"c-est\" value=\"es\"><span>Matched event study</span></label>\n        </div>\n      </fieldset>\n      <fieldset>\n        <legend>Fold</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Fold\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"c-fold\" value=\"ho\" checked><span>Held-out</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"c-fold\" value=\"scr\"><span>Screen</span></label>\n        </div>\n      </fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-closure\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></span>Confirmed on held-out</li><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--muted)\"></span>Not confirmed</li><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--amber)\"></span>Burt constraint (positive)</li><li><span class=\"sw dash\"></span>No difference</li></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-closure\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Measures: <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"persist\">persistent-neighbour closure</button>, <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"burt\">Burt constraint</button>. Values are rounded to two decimals from the figure registry's three-decimal values (evaluation 9, <code>figures/F4/plotted_values.json</code>, drawn from evaluation 3). <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"holm\">Holm</button> p-values test the held-out panel coefficient.</p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>\n  <ul class=\"lim\">\n    <li><strong>The strict model is inconclusive on held-out.</strong> With concept-by-year and host-by-year fixed effects, the held-out IRR is 0.98 (95% CI 0.70 to 1.37) on 250 of 972 events and 30 clusters, declared underpowered in advance. The held-out confirmation rests on the co-primary specification.</li>\n    <li><strong>Graded, not a threshold.</strong> Binary establishment (at least three newcomer papers, with host papers in at least three of the five years) is null on the held-out fold (p = 0.165).</li>\n    <li><strong>Population.</strong> The pool is dominated by physics and computer-science concepts from arXiv. The MeSH replication covers biomedicine-to-biomedicine entries only. Social sciences, humanities and engineering are untested.</li>\n    <li><strong>What the held-out fold protects.</strong> Its outcomes were sealed and opened once, but its entry events, pre-entry features and size came from the same pipeline, and an early experiment computed origin-series summaries for 61 of its concepts.</li>\n    <li><strong>Single-paper entries.</strong> 87% of co-primary Screen events involve a single entry-year paper. The pooled multi-team effect is positive (IRR 1.28, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.48); the held-out fold alone is underpowered for this test.</li>\n    <li><strong>Inference.</strong> The cluster-robust variance estimator rejects 10% to 11% of null shuffles in simulation (target 5%). Wild-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests agree with the held-out result (wild p = 0.012, permutation p = 0.026).</li>\n    <li><strong>Host-specificity.</strong> The Balassa-index lift measure has a within-fixed-effect correlation of 0.997 with the log of the continuous share, so it confirms the share rather than adding independent evidence.</li>\n    <li><strong>Adopters.</strong> Adopters are enriched for prior exposure to the entry partners (OR 3.09; prevalence 0.79 vs. 0.61), on the Screen fold only. The design cannot separate absorptive capacity from topical proximity.</li>\n    <li><strong>Closure.</strong> The one confirmed closure row had a screen event-study interval that included zero, 17 of 25 held-out controls are screen concepts, and covariate balance is poor.</li>\n  </ul>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"about\" aria-labelledby=\"h-about\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-about\">Sources and glossary</h2>\n  <h3>Where each view's data comes from</h3>\n  <ul class=\"prov\">\n    <li><strong>The finding (forest of IRRs):</strong> evaluation 9 (<em>Paper figures drawn straight from result files</em>), <code>figures/F2/plotted_values.json</code>, which re-reads experiment 7 <code>results/d2_summary.json</code>, evaluation 2 <code>results/heldout_post.json</code> and experiment 9 <code>results/g4_models.json</code>.</li>\n    <li><strong>How it works (stepper):</strong> experiment 7 <code>method_out.json</code> (the EPR steering entry, W1 features, outcome and out-of-fold predictions) and dataset 5 <code>full_data_out/full_data_out_1.json</code> (concept pool record); SD of the share from evaluation 6 <code>results/k1_decomposition.json</code>.</li>\n    <li><strong>Uptake by share groups, entry browser, threshold view, exceptions:</strong> experiment 7 <code>method_out.json</code> (1,740 Screen entries), evaluation 2 <code>eval_out.json</code> dataset <code>d2_heldout_events</code> (1,097 held-out entries), experiment 9 <code>method_out.json</code> (2,249 MeSH entries). Concept names from dataset 5 and dataset 3; subfield names from dataset 1 <code>taxonomy.json</code>. All entries are embedded; no sampling.</li>\n    <li><strong>Margins:</strong> evaluation 6 <code>results/k1_decomposition.json</code>.</li>\n    <li><strong>Cases:</strong> evaluation 4 <code>eval_out.json</code>, dataset <code>case_entries</code>.</li>\n    <li><strong>Closure (RQ1):</strong> evaluation 9 <code>figures/F4/plotted_values.json</code>, which re-reads evaluation 3 <code>results/r1/r1_summary.json</code> and <code>results/tables/</code>.</li>\n  </ul>\n  <h3>Glossary</h3>\n  <dl class=\"gloss\" id=\"gloss\"></dl>\n  <h3>Links</h3>\n  <p class=\"links\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_MvbsSpVmwUlA/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_MvbsSpVmwUlA/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_MvbsSpVmwUlA\">Code repository</a>\n  </p>\n</section>\n</main>\n<footer>\n  <div class=\"in\">\n    <p class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_MvbsSpVmwUlA/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_MvbsSpVmwUlA/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_MvbsSpVmwUlA\">Code repository</a>\n    </p>\n    <p class=\"note\">The paper carries no citation block.
